verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs imply region-specific tenants: Vanta 'hosts a separate MCP server in each region' and tells you to 'find the region for your Vanta instance' (vanta-docs-54). Its API reference also offers a separate 'Vanta Gov (FedRAMP)' server at api.vanta-gov.com (vanta-docs-80). This suggests data lives in distinct regional or government environments, but nothing documents a customer choosing a storage region or getting a residency guarantee. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of customer-selectable data residency, a list of available regions, residency guarantees for stored compliance data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
